Container.Name: hermes-agent
Container.Overview: Nous Research Hermes Agent on Tower03. Based on medzin's CA template (official image). Model, memory (Hindsight on Tower04) and other settings live in /opt/data/config.yaml; secrets go in /opt/data/.env or the masked fields below. Dashboard and API server ship OFF: set HERMES_DASHBOARD=1 only after setting the dashboard password, and API_SERVER_ENABLED=true only after setting API_SERVER_KEY.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: All Hermes state (config.yaml, .env, hindsight/config.json). Real disk path, not /mnt/user, so the 10000:10000 ownership sticks.

Config.Name: API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API server port (only listens when API_SERVER_ENABLED=true).

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD
Config.Description: 1 = run the dashboard. Set the password below first.

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Dashboard login password. Required before HERMES_DASHBOARD=1. LAN/VPN only.

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional session signing secret (openssl rand -hex 32) so logins survive restarts.

Config.Name: API_SERVER_ENABLED
Config.Description: true = run the OpenAI-compatible API on 8642. Set API_SERVER_KEY first.

Config.Name: API_SERVER_KEY
Config.Description: Bearer token for the API server (8+ characters).

Config.Name: HERMES_UID
Config.Description: Must be 1000-65534; appdata must be owned by it.

Config.Name: HERMES_GID
Config.Description: Must be 1000-65534; appdata must be owned by it.
